name: Chunked Otsu Thresholding
definition: An implementation of Otsu's thresholding algorithm that processes histogram counts in chunks to reduce memory usage, avoiding the creation of a full float64 copy of the volume data.
summary: Chunked Otsu Thresholding computes volume thresholds by processing data in small chunks to accumulate histograms, reducing peak memory usage while maintaining numerical identity with full-dataset results.
